Ghostty terminal-session core -- Surface (src/Surface.zig)
|
|-- Surface control and runtime boundary
|   |-- Public interface: init(), deinit(), handleMessage(), close(), *Callback()
|   |   `-- One terminal widget/session; window, tab and split layout belong to the host
|   |-- Retained state: id, focused, visible, readonly, child_exited, command_timer
|   |-- app, rt_app, rt_surface -- references, not owned application objects
|   |   |-- -> App tracks active surfaces and dispatches its mailbox (src/App.zig)
|   |   `-- -> apprt.runtime supplies native UI/services (src/apprt.zig)
|   |-- surfaceMailbox(), handleMessage() (src/Surface.zig; src/apprt/surface.zig)
|   |   |-- -> App.mailbox carries surface-addressed messages to the main thread
|   |   `-- -> rt_app.performAction(): titles, notifications, scrollbar and UI changes
|   `-- Lifecycle implementation: init(), deinit(), needsConfirmQuit(), close()
|       |-- init() -> constructs Termio and renderer; starts IO and renderer workers
|       |-- deinit() -> stops/joins search, renderer and IO before releasing shared state
|       `-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit()); host completes destruction
|
|-- Configuration, font selection and geometry (src/Surface.zig)
|   |-- config: DerivedConfig; config_conditional_state: ConditionalState
|   |   |-- Holds copied surface settings, bindings and font configuration
|   |   `-- updateConfig() -> replaces derived settings; messages Termio and renderer
|   |-- font_grid_key, font_size, font_metrics, font_size_adjusted
|   |   |-- setFontSize() -> App.font_grid_set.ref(); renderer accepts new grid
|   |   |-- -> App-owned font.SharedGridSet shares matching font configurations
|   |   |-- -> SharedGrid supplies resolver/fallbacks, glyph caches and color/grayscale atlases
|   |   |   (src/font/SharedGrid.zig; shared storage is not owned by this Surface)
|   |   `-- Surface retains a grid reference; replacement/shutdown releases the old reference
|   `-- size: renderer.Size -- screen, cell and padding geometry
|       |-- contentScaleCallback(), sizeCallback(), setCellSize(), resize()
|       |-- Font metrics + pixel dimensions + padding -> terminal grid dimensions
|       `-- resize() -> IO resize message and renderer resize message
|
|-- User interaction and terminal actions (src/Surface.zig)
|   |-- keyboard: Keyboard; pressed_key; last_binding_trigger
|   |   |-- Subparts: key-sequence tracking, queued input and active key-table stack
|   |   |-- keyCallback() -> maybeHandleBinding() -> performBindingAction()
|   |   |-- Unhandled bindings -> encodeKey() -> input.key_encode.encode()
|   |   `-- encodeKeyOpts() -> io.terminal modes; protocol state determines emitted bytes
|   |-- mouse: Mouse -- buttons, modifiers, links and SelectionGesture
|   |   |-- mouseButtonCallback(), cursorPosCallback(), scrollCallback(), mouseReport()
|   |   |-- -> io.terminal: selection, viewport movement and application mouse-report modes
|   |   `-- -> input.mouse_encode and runtime URL-opening services
|   |-- Text, IME and clipboard operations
|   |   |-- textCallback(), preeditCallback(), copySelectionToClipboards()
|   |   |-- startClipboardRequest(), completeClipboardRequest(), denyClipboardRequest()
|   |   |-- -> renderer_state.preedit for composition display
|   |   `-- -> runtime clipboard services; paste encoding depends on terminal modes
|   `-- queueIo() -- common outgoing-message gate
|       |-- -> io.queueMessage(): transfers message ownership to the IO mailbox
|       `-- readonly suppresses PTY writes, not selection, scrolling or copying
|
|-- Session IO and emulation: io, io_thread, io_thr
|   |-- io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|   |   |-- backend: termio.Backend.exec -- subprocess and PTY (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|   |   |   |-- Subparts: Subprocess, command/environment, shell integration, read worker
|   |   |   |-- threadEnter() -> starts child, watches exit and starts PTY reader
|   |   |   `-- PTY reader -> Termio.processOutput(); exit notification -> Surface
|   |   |-- terminal_stream: StreamHandler.Stream (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|   |   |   |-- Subparts: terminal.Stream parser, APC/DCS handlers, clipboard protocol state
|   |   |   |-- processOutput() -> nextSlice() -> StreamHandler -> terminal operations
|   |   |   |-- -> renderer_state.mutex protects terminal mutations
|   |   |   `-- Handler -> IO replies, Surface messages and renderer wakeups
|   |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal -- authoritative emulator state
|   |   |   |-- screens: ScreenSet -- primary/alternate Screen instances
|   |   |   |   `-- PageList grid/scrollback, cursor, selection, charset, Kitty images/keyboard
|   |   |   |-- Modes, colors, tabstops, scrolling region, title, working directory
|   |   |   |-- Implements text/grid editing, screen switching, scrolling and resize
|   |   |   `-- Sources: src/terminal/Terminal.zig, ScreenSet.zig, Screen.zig
|   |   `-- mailbox, DerivedConfig and resize()/changeConfig() operations
|   |       `-- resize() -> PTY resize + Terminal.resize() under the shared mutex
|   `-- io_thread: termio.Thread; io_thr: worker handle (src/termio/Thread.zig)
|       |-- Subparts: event loop, stop signal, resize-coalescing and selection-scroll timers
|       |-- Writer-side message handling -> backend writes and Termio operations
|       `-- Synchronized-output timeout -> resets a stalled rendering pause
|
|-- Presentation: renderer, renderer_state, renderer_thread, renderer_thr
|   |-- renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)
|   |   |-- Holds shared-access mutex, preedit text and render-facing mouse state
|   |   |-- terminal pointer -> io.terminal; inspector pointer -> optional Inspector
|   |   `-- lockDemand()/unlockDemand() coordinate frame snapshots with busy IO parsing
|   |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) (src/renderer.zig; src/renderer/generic.zig)
|   |   |-- Subparts: terminal.RenderState snapshot, font.Shaper, GPU frames and shaders
|   |   |-- updateFrame() -> snapshots shared terminal state under renderer_state lock
|   |   |-- Snapshot + font grid + selection/search highlights -> renderable cells/images
|   |   |-- drawFrame() -> Metal or OpenGL graphics API
|   |   `-- -> borrows App.device and shared font grid; owns per-surface rendering resources
|   `-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread; renderer_thr: worker handle
|       |-- Subparts: mailbox, event loop, wakeup/draw signals, blink/animation timers
|       |-- Also schedules incremental scrollback compression (src/renderer/Thread.zig)
|       |-- Wakeup -> renderer.updateFrame() -> drawFrame(); visibility gates work
|       `-- Surface.draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true) for host-driven synchronous drawing
|
|-- Search: optional Surface.Search (src/Surface.zig)
|   |-- state: terminal.search.Thread; thread: worker handle
|   |   |-- Subparts: mailbox, refresh timer, TerminalSearch/ScreenSearch and match tracking
|   |   `-- -> io.terminal under shared locking; copies data to reduce lock duration
|   |-- searchCallback_() -> renderer mailbox with viewport/selected-match highlights
|   |-- searchCallback_() -> Surface mailbox with match count and selected index
|   `-- Search.deinit() stops and joins the worker (src/terminal/search/Thread.zig)
|
`-- Inspector: optional owned Inspector (src/inspector/Inspector.zig)
    |-- Subparts: GUI state, mouse inspection, keyboard event history and VT stream recording
    |-- activateInspector()/deactivateInspector() (src/Surface.zig)
    |   `-- -> renderer_state inspector reference; notifies renderer and IO workers
    |-- recordKeyEvent() receives input events and their encoded PTY bytes
    `-- Termio.processOutput() -> recordPtyRead(); byte-wise inspection is enabled only on demand
</core-component-diagram>

<task>
Model

- HierGraph = (V, T, E)
  - V is a finite set of nodes.
  - T is a set of ordered pairs from V x V. The graph (V, T) is directed and acyclic.
  - E is also a set of ordered pairs from V x V. Its relations may form cycles.
  - Vertical (compositional). (whole, part) in T means part is a direct part of whole. Following T downward moves from a whole into its parts. A shared part can have several parents and retain one identity.
  - Horizontal (relational). (u, v) in E records a relation from u to v. Its meaning comes from the particular graph. The endpoints can occur at different vertical levels.
  - A root has no incoming T edge. A leaf has no outgoing T edge. Multiple roots, shared descendants, disconnected components, and isolated nodes are all valid.

Task

You are given a diagram that compresses the core of a codebase into a single dense view: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application's main behavior and state are organized. Many components share one tree. Their composition is flattened and their relations are mentioned only in passing.

Your task is to propose a plan for spreading this coverage out along two dimensions:
- Vertically, by decomposing nodes into their parts, i.e. extending T downward.
- Horizontally, by tracing the relations between nodes, i.e. extending E.

The plan should say where the diagram is too compressed in each dimension and how to open it up.

Shape of the plan

The plan opens the diagram up with a mix of three moves. Use each one where it fits. You do not need to use all three.

1. New diagrams on the same canvas
   Add a diagram next to the input diagram when it elaborates one of the input's nodes or relations in place. Anchor it to the exact node it elaborates.
   - Vertical: the diagram decomposes the anchor node into its parts.
   - Horizontal: the diagram traces a relation, or a chain of relations, that starts at or passes through the anchor.

2. Child canvases
   Open a new canvas below a node when that node's own composition and internal relations are rich enough to need a canvas of their own. A child canvas is one T step down from its anchor node: its diagrams together describe that node.

3. Same-level canvases
   Open a new canvas beside the current one when a body of related responsibilities sits at the same level as the core and is linked to it mainly through E, e.g. a subsystem the core calls, feeds or listens to. State which relations connect it to the current canvas.

For each canvas in the plan, the current one included, describe:
- Each diagram: what it covers, which dimension it extends, and which node or relation it is anchored to.
- How the diagrams relate: the composition (T) and relation (E) links between them, each with a direction and a short meaning, plus the links to diagrams on other canvases.

Ground every proposal in the source. Point to the input diagram's nodes where it is compressed, and to the files that show the composition or relation being uncovered. Do not propose diagrams that repeat each other's coverage.
</task>

# Compression

## Vertical
- `User interaction and terminal actions (src/Surface.zig)`: combines retained keyboard/mouse state, binding dispatch, protocol encoding and asynchronous clipboard transactions. Keyboard tables borrow configuration data; clipboard requests have distinct ownership and permission paths. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/apprt/structs.zig`.
- `Session IO and emulation: io, io_thread, io_thr`: hides the distinction between Surface-owned fields, Termio-owned state and backend thread-local resources. POSIX output uses separate gather and parse workers, not just one reader. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/Termio.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`, `src/termio/Thread.zig`.
- `terminal: terminal.Terminal -- authoritative emulator state`: compresses Terminal → ScreenSet → Screens → PageList. Cursor, selection, charset and Kitty state are Screen members alongside PageList, not its children. PageList contains page storage, tracked pins, viewport and compression continuation state. Sources: `src/terminal/Terminal.zig`, `src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig`, `src/terminal/Screen.zig`, `src/terminal/PageList.zig`.
- `Presentation: renderer, renderer_state, renderer_thread, renderer_thr`: flattens four Surface members. The renderer contains a snapshot, shaping state, renderable cells/images, graphics resources and a separate draw mutex; renderer.State references the authoritative terminal. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`, `src/renderer/State.zig`, `src/renderer/Thread.zig`.
- `Search: optional Surface.Search (src/Surface.zig)`: hides per-screen searchers, an active-viewport search and screen-generation tracking beneath the worker. Sources: `src/terminal/search/Thread.zig`, `src/terminal/search/terminal.zig`.
- `Inspector: optional owned Inspector (src/inspector/Inspector.zig)`: keyboard history and VT recording sit beneath GUI state; the renderer-state inspector pointer is only a reference. Sources: `src/inspector/Inspector.zig`, `src/Surface.zig`.
- `app, rt_app, rt_surface -- references, not owned application objects`: adjacent application responsibilities deserve separate identities. App owns the shared font-grid set and render device; the grid set owns reference-counted grids. Sources: `src/App.zig`, `src/font/SharedGridSet.zig`, `src/font/SharedGrid.zig`.

## Horizontal
- `surfaceMailbox(), handleMessage() (src/Surface.zig; src/apprt/surface.zig)`: surface mailboxes are addressing wrappers over App’s queue. Posting wakes the runtime; dispatch checks that the destination surface still exists. Sources: `src/apprt/surface.zig`, `src/App.zig`.
- `Lifecycle implementation: init(), deinit(), needsConfirmQuit(), close()`: close requests cross into the host, whereas destruction stops and joins workers before releasing shared state. Renderer destruction must precede renderer-thread-state destruction because of display-link callbacks. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/apprt/embedded.zig`.
- `Configuration, font selection and geometry (src/Surface.zig)`: reload invalidates binding references, acquires a grid, transfers its replacement to the renderer and sends independently derived worker configurations. Resize reaches the renderer both directly and after IO resizes the PTY and terminal. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/renderer/Thread.zig`, `src/termio/Termio.zig`.
- `queueIo() -- common outgoing-message gate`: ownership transfer, readonly filtering and bounded-queue backpressure are compressed into one arrow. Protocol handlers can send directly to the IO mailbox; this is not a universal gate for every PTY write. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/mailbox.zig`, `src/termio/stream_handler.zig`.
- `renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)`: shared locking connects parsing, interaction, search and frame snapshots. Demand counters and reader yielding prevent busy parsing from starving snapshots. Sources: `src/renderer/State.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`.
- `Text, IME and clipboard operations`: mixes display-only preedit, ordinary paste, OSC 52 and Kitty clipboard permission/response cycles. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/stream_handler.zig`, `src/apprt/embedded.zig`.
- `renderer_thread: renderer.Thread; renderer_thr: worker handle`: wakeup, snapshot and drawing are not an unconditional linear sequence. Visibility, synchronized output and vsync affect execution; compression scheduling also reaches back into terminal storage. Sources: `src/renderer/Thread.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`.

# Canvases

Node-qualified references below identify endpoints inside diagrams. Repeated endpoint references retain one identity; they do not create additional owned copies. T denotes direct composition, never a call, pointer or scheduling relationship.

### Diagrams
- **core · Surface ownership index**: vertical; anchored to the supplied root `Ghostty terminal-session core -- Surface (src/Surface.zig)`. Retain the input diagram as a corrected, collapsed index of Surface fields and responsibility groups. Distinguish owned members from external references. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`.
- **lifecycle · Construction and teardown boundary**: horizontal; anchored to Session/core → `Lifecycle implementation: init(), deinit(), needsConfirmQuit(), close()`. Show initialization, worker startup, host-mediated close and ordered teardown. Include search → renderer → IO stop/join ordering, backend reader shutdown, renderer-before-thread-state destruction and final grid release. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`, `src/apprt/embedded.zig`.
- **reconfigure · Configuration, font and resize propagation**: horizontal; anchored to Session/core → `Configuration, font selection and geometry (src/Surface.zig)`. Trace conditional configuration, binding-state invalidation, grid acquisition/replacement, derived worker configurations and geometry fan-out. Mark IO resize coalescing and the subsequent renderer resize notification. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/Thread.zig`, `src/termio/Termio.zig`, `src/renderer/Thread.zig`.
- **search · Search composition and result ports**: vertical; anchored to Session/core → `Search: optional Surface.Search (src/Surface.zig)`. # Summary

The plan uses five canvases: the current canvas, three child canvases and one application-level peer. Vertical expansion concentrates on interaction state, IO/emulator storage and presentation ownership. Horizontal expansion exposes asynchronous delivery, ownership transfer, locking and host boundaries without duplicating component interiors.

Verified at `ea8b12a8a9894b5259c441eadd8f6f0c65e215af`. Key corrections and qualifications:

- POSIX output has gather and parse workers; Windows retains a serial reader.
- Cursor, selection, charset and Kitty state belong to Screen, alongside PageList.
- Font replacement releases the old reference on renderer-thread acceptance.
- `queueIo()` filters Surface-originated writes, not every protocol-generated PTY reply.
- Rendering is gated and paced, not an unconditional wakeup → snapshot → draw chain; snapshot work can also mutate viewport/animation state.
- Termio resize sends an additional renderer notification after resizing.
- Runtime embedding can contain the core Surface; Surface’s references back to runtime objects do not imply ownership.
